Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the release date of *Niyoti* as 24 June 2016 when the earliest widely recognized release date was actually 10 June 2016, based on the information provided by WebSurfer. The Planner focused on the "official worldwide release date" (24 June 2016) rather than the earlier India-wide release date (10 June 2016), which was also cited in multiple sources. This misinterpretation of the data led to the incorrect conclusion that *Angali Pangali* (17 June 2016) was released earlier than *Niyoti*. The error occurred in the Planner's analysis at step 7.
